# Positivity, floors and limiters {#sec-ch08}

<!-- PROVENANCE
pin: snapy@c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f (chengcli/snapy)
sources: OUTLINE.md 8
status: draft

This chapter is every mechanism that keeps the state physically admissible, or detects that it is not.

The most important thing to say comes first, because the rest of the chapter reads differently once it is said.
**snapy guarantees no thermodynamic positivity of density or pressure.** There is exactly one guarantee in this
chapter, and it covers tracer channels under explicit transport. That is the limiter of @sec-ch08-theta, which cannot
drain a cell below zero in a stage. Everything protecting density, pressure and temperature is a floor, which is to
say a clamp that invents whatever the state was missing. The only backstop is a detector that asks for the step to be
taken again. The chapter's own check measures what the floors invent rather than describing them as safeguards.

The second thing worth knowing early is that one switch controls most of it.
`equation-of-state/limiter`, default false, turns on the tracer limiter, the equation-of-state floors,
the reconstruction face floors and the species clamps together. They cannot be selected independently, except that
the face-flux covariance rows, on by default, also turn the tracer and scalar limiters on, without the floors
(@sec-ch08-theta). The coupling is a documented design decision, not an accident of the implementation.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch08-deps
#| fig-cap: "The dependency map of this chapter. Dashed green arrows read turns on: one switch controls the tracer limiter, the passive scalars, the equation-of-state floors and the face floors together, and the covariance rows, on by default in 2-D and 3-D, also turn on the tracer limiter and the passive scalars, without the floors. Solid black arrows read requires or sets, dotted vermillion reads falls back to, and dash-dotted blue reads read by. The two paths on the right end at the redo detector, which is the only consumer of the limiter marks and of the implicit dry clamp. Every edge is stated and cited in the section it comes from."
#| fig-alt: "Twelve labelled boxes joined by arrows of four styles, with a switch box at the left feeding four mechanisms, a covariance box above it feeding two of them, and two paths converging on a redo detector at the right."
#| echo: false

make_fig()
```

| scheme | switch | default | guarantee | main test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tracer flux limiter (@sec-ch08-theta) | `limiter`[^rg-9411b882dbd0], or a covariance row | on in 2-D and 3-D through the covariance rows; otherwise off | non-negative tracers under transport, per stage | `test_flux_positivity` |
| Energy and momentum carry (@sec-ch08-carry) | with the tracer limiter | as the tracer limiter | the withheld mass keeps its energy | `test_flux_positivity_carry` |
| Passive-scalar limiter (@sec-ch08-scalar) | `limiter`, or the scalar's covariance row | as the tracer limiter | the same, for scalars | none |
| EOS[^rg-5c35e4c74097] limiter and floors (@sec-ch08-eoslimiter) | `limiter` | off | none; a clamp that invents mass | none |
| Condensate borrow (@sec-ch08-borrow) | with the limiter | off | conservative in mass and elements | none |
| Vapour column repair (@sec-ch08-fixvapor) | with the limiter | off | conservative in mass, moves only the deficit, or it throws | `test_fix_vapor_deficit` |
| Face floors (@sec-ch08-reconfloors) | `limiter`; density and pressure also need `shock`[^rg-0ecdbd193411] false | off | none; a clamp at the face | `test_species_face_clamp` |
| Well-balanced face fallback (@sec-ch08-wbface) | with the reference | none | no-op at rest | @sec-ch05 tests |
| Implicit dry clamp (@sec-ch08-vic) | with the implicit scheme | none | none; recorded, not prevented | none |
| Round-off thresholds (@sec-ch08-roundoff) | none | always | separates a repair from arithmetic | this chapter's check |
| Floor detector and redo (@sec-ch08-redo) | none | always | detection only | none |
| Dry-carry zero-base guard (@sec-ch08-drycarry) | with scalars and dry sources | none | finiteness, *not* positivity | `test_dry_carry_zero_base` |

: The mechanisms of this chapter. "Guarantee" is what the mechanism actually promises; most promise
nothing and repair instead. {#tbl-ch08-schemes}

Two notes on how the chapter is organised. The carry of energy and momentum is one section, although it is one
mechanism seen from two sides. The equation-of-state limiter is one section for its conserved pass, its primitive
pass, the floors and the marks, because one switch and shared marks make them one story. The vapour column repair and
the condensate borrow have their own sections. They are the only repairs in the chapter that conserve anything.

Where this chapter touches others: the limiter runs inside the stage operator of @sec-ch04-divergence,
between the Riemann solve and the flux divergence, and after the seam averaging of @sec-ch04-seam. The
face floors belong to the reconstruction framework of @sec-ch04-framework. The implicit clamp is inside
the solve of the time-integration chapter, and the redo budget that ends a redo loop belongs there too.
